source_title: TVK leader Christopher arrested for sexually harassing college student after offering lift
source_excerpt: KANYAKUMARI: A functionary of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) was arrested on Thursday for allegedly sexually harassing a college student after offering her a lift home in Tamil Naduâs Kanyakumari district, police said.Christopher, a member of the partyâs central district executive committee, had been absconding since a case was registered against him. She regularly travelled with another student from Moolachal, who is also a TVK member, police sources said.On the day of the incident, the two students were waiting for a bus after college when it began raining.
